title: New BOC, BIR, BCDA heads take oath before Marcos
summary: The new head of the Bureau of Customs, Bureau of Internal Revenue, and the Bases Conversion and Development Authority took their oath before President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday.

blocks.text: The new head of the Bureau of Customs, Bureau of Internal Revenue, and the Bases Conversion and Development Authority took their oath before President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday.
Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) Commissioner Charlito Mendoza will move to head Bureau of Customs (BOC).
Finance Department official Rolando Ligon Jr. takes over as the country's top taxman.
Meanwhile, BOC Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno is the new head of the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA). —VAL, GMA News
